name: Adtraction
shortInfo: Adtraction helps you find the right marketing partners to grow your business
brief: Adtraction connects you to diverse marketing partners to reach your audience and increase sales
about:
Get access to Statistics through this Adtraction connector. It enables streaming of relevant Adtraction data into a user determined data warehouse automatically once you configure the relevant pipelines.

Check more about Adtraction api documentation [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/adtraction/index.html).
